description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target player during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Game of Chaos by paying {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve Game of Chaos, choosing to continue flipping a coin until the opponent loses the flip and the amount of life wagered is greater than or equal to the opponent's life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
